meta.scope: Thailand Batch 7 — Further provincial densification: EEC core provinces (Chonburi, Rayong), secondary poles (Chiang Mai, Phuket), and spatial contrast framing.

candidates.title: Chonburi Gross Provincial Product
candidates.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC)
candidates.description: Official GPP for Chonburi — a core Eastern Economic Corridor province combining deep-sea port (Laem Chabang), industrial estates, automotive and logistics with tourism (Pattaya). Consistently among the largest provincial economies after Bangkok.

candidates.title: Rayong Gross Provincial Product
candidates.description: Official GPP for Rayong — the industrial heart of the EEC, anchored by Map Ta Phut petrochemical complex, refineries and heavy industry. Frequently ranks among the highest in GPP per capita.

candidates.title: Chiang Mai Gross Provincial Product
candidates.description: Official GPP for Chiang Mai — the principal northern urban and tourism/services pole, ranking among the larger provincial economies outside the Central–Eastern core.

candidates.title: Phuket Gross Provincial Product
candidates.description: Official GPP for Phuket — the principal southern island tourism economy. Highly sensitive to international visitor arrivals and a key node in the national tourism statistics.

candidates.title: Thailand further-provincial densification meta-node
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Chonburi and Rayong (EEC core), Chiang Mai (northern pole) and Phuket (southern tourism) GPP series into a coherent further-provincial layer that complements Bangkok and the earlier EEC framing.
